name: Pegalajar (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided sapphire blue over violet, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pegalajar (a castle on red and a lion on white).
history: The flag of Pegalajar is a rectangular taffeta flag of 2:3, divided horizontally into two equal parts, the upper half sapphire blue and the lower half violet, charged at the centre with the municipal arms beneath a closed Spanish royal crown.

features.role: Pegalajar arms — castle on red and lion on white
